strategy.name: Aggressive (Quality) Paper — reigned in
strategy.desc: Concentrated swing and momentum trades in quality large/mid-cap US stocks and liquid broad/sector ETFs. No leveraged ETFs, no crypto, no penny stocks (<$10). Risk 7% per trade, 30% position cap. Holds 1 week to ~5 years. Lets winners run with 18% trailing stops; cuts quick on thesis breaks. Paper-only sandbox.
rules: Universe: quality large/mid-cap US stocks + liquid broad/sector ETFs (SPY/QQQ/XLK/XLC/SMH-type). NO leveraged/inverse ETFs. NO crypto. NO stocks <$10.
Size by risk: shares = (7% × equity) ÷ (entry − stop), capped at 30% of equity per name.
Regime overlay: RISK-ON (VIX<16) full size; NEUTRAL (16-24) trim 25%; RISK-OFF (>24) high-conviction only.
Stop on every entry: ~18% trailing (wider only with dated catalyst). Never remove or widen a stop.
Cut at −12% from entry unless thesis intact + imminent catalyst. Time-stop dead money at ~2-3 weeks.
Halt at −8% daily loss. Stand down (no new trades) at −25% MTD until CJ resumes.
